Name: Kenneth's Artisan Goods Addon
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Artisan Goods Addon[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]No time to wait for your Kegs & Jars? Get all vanilla artisan goods instantly at Kenneth's Grocery Store![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What it does:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]🛒 18 Vanilla Artisan Goods added to Kenneth's Grocery Store (Shop 1) - all year-round![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Includes:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]🧀 Cheese & Goat Cheese[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]🥚 Mayonnaise, Duck Mayonnaise & Void Mayonnaise[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]🍯 Honey & Cloth[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]🥒 Pickles & Jelly (Preserves Jar)[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]🍷 Wine, Juice, Beer, Pale Ale, Mead, Oil, Truffle Oil, Coffee & Green Tea[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]💰 Premium price for balance, so it won't replace your artisan machines. For convenience & late-game![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Why get this?[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Perfect if you need quick gifts (everyone loves Wine & Cheese), quick cooking ingredients (Oil, Vinegar), or you just don't want to wait 7 days for your Keg![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Grocery Store (Required)[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ [/b][/size]

[b][size=4]Lightweight & Balanced - no new items, just vanilla goods in Kenneth's Grocery Store![/size][/b]
